notes.beforeInstall: Needs Elden Ring 1.17.1 (2.7.1.0) and Call of Duty: Black Ops II - Zombies installed. Elden Ring runs offline through ModEngine2 with Easy Anti-Cheat off: use a separate save if you also play online. Black Ops II doesn't run: its round music, perk jingles and stings are read from your own copy.
notes.firstLaunch: The first Play reads Black Ops II Zombies' sound names from your copy in the background while Elden Ring loads; the BO2 music and stings switch on when it's done. Load your character and Round 1 starts at the grace: F5 Juggernog, F6 Speed Cola, F7 Double Tap, F8 Quick Revive.
